name: All In One Unipile Linkedin Auto Reply

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Company Page RAG Bot — Full System (3 Workflows)

### How it works
1. Workflow 1 watches a Google Drive folder and automatically chunks, embeds, and indexes new documents into a Pinecone knowledge base.
2. Workflow 2 receives incoming LinkedIn messages via a Unipile webhook, classifies each message's intent, and drafts a reply grounded in the Pinecone knowledge base.
3. Every drafted reply is saved to Airtable, and either sent automatically or held for human approval depending on the autoSend toggle.
4. Workflow 3 triggers when a human approves a pending draft in Airtable, sending the approved reply via Unipile and updating its status.
5. All three workflows log errors to a shared Airtable Errors table for troubleshooting.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Reconnect the Google Drive credential (Workflow 1)
- [ ] Reconnect the Unipile credential (all HTTP nodes currently return 401)
- [ ] Replace the placeholder DSN (api1.unipile.com:13111) with your real Unipile DSN in Workflow 2 and Workflow 3's HTTP Request nodes
- [ ] Create the Unipile webhook (source: messaging) pointing at Workflow 2's production URL once activated
- [ ] Set up the Airtable "Run a script" automation on the Drafts table (trigger: status = approved) to call Workflow 3's webhook
- [ ] Add your company name and description to Generate RAG Reply's system prompt (Workflow 2)
- [ ] Confirm the Pinecone index dimensions match your Gemini embedding model output
- [ ] Activate all three workflows once the above is complete

### Customization
Flip the autoSend field on Workflow 2's Config node to true once you trust the AI's replies, to skip human review and send automatically.

nodes.name: Group - Watch and download source file

parameters.content:
## Watch and download source file

Watches the Google Drive folder for new or updated documents and downloads each one as binary data.

nodes.name: Group - Chunk, embed, and log to knowledge base

parameters.content:
## Chunk, embed, and log to knowledge base

Splits the document into 500-token chunks (50 overlap), embeds them with Gemini, upserts into the Pinecone company-knowledge-base index (namespace: company-kb), then logs the result to Airtable KB Log.

nodes.name: Group - Receive and validate approval payload

parameters.content:
## Receive and validate approval payload

Receives the webhook fired by Airtable's automation script when a draft is approved, extracts the payload fields, and validates that all required fields are present with status = approved. Invalid payloads are logged to Airtable (Log Invalid Payload sits just below this cluster).

nodes.name: Group - Send the approved reply via Unipile

parameters.content:
## Send the approved reply via Unipile

Posts the approved draft text to the LinkedIn conversation via Unipile's send-message endpoint.

nodes.name: Group - Update or flag draft status

parameters.content:
## Update or flag draft status

Marks the Airtable draft as sent on success, or as send_failed with an accompanying error log entry on failure.

options.systemMessage: =You are the LinkedIn page assistant for our company. Search the knowledge base tool before every reply. Never invent pricing, features, or facts. If unsure, say a human will follow up shortly. Reply in the language the sender used. Keep replies to 3-5 sentences, LinkedIn inbox style. Message category: {{ $('Classify Message').item.json.output.category }} ({{ $('Classify Message').item.json.output.reason }})

parameters.toolDescription: Search the company knowledge base for facts about products, pricing, features, and policies before answering a customer question.

options.systemMessage: Classify the latest LinkedIn message into exactly one category: LEAD (product, service, pricing, or demo interest), SUPPORT (existing customer needing help), PARTNERSHIP (business collaboration proposal), RECRUITMENT (job inquiry or recruiter outreach), SPAM (irrelevant, mass outreach, or bot), OTHER (anything else). Return the category, a confidence score between 0 and 1, and a short reason. Respond with JSON only.

nodes.name: Group - Receive webhook and normalize payload

parameters.content:
## Receive webhook and normalize payload

Receives the incoming LinkedIn message from Unipile, responds immediately, sets the auto-send config default, and extracts/normalizes the relevant fields from the webhook payload.

nodes.name: Group - Validate sender and fetch conversation history

parameters.content:
## Validate sender and fetch conversation history

Filters for genuine inbound company-page messages (not spam, not self-sent), then fetches the last 6 messages and formats them into a chronological transcript. Fetch errors are logged to Airtable.

nodes.name: Group - Classify message and check for spam

parameters.content:
## Classify message and check for spam

Classifies the message's intent (LEAD/SUPPORT/PARTNERSHIP/RECRUITMENT/SPAM/OTHER) using Claude via OpenRouter with shared session memory, then routes spam messages to a dedicated Airtable log (Log Spam sits just to the right, sharing this cluster).

nodes.name: Group - Generate grounded reply via Pinecone

parameters.content:
## Generate grounded reply via Pinecone

Generates the reply using the same shared Claude model and session memory from classification, grounding every answer in the Pinecone knowledge base via a retrieval tool with matching Gemini embeddings.

nodes.name: Group - Save draft and check auto-send toggle

parameters.content:
## Save draft and check auto-send toggle

Upserts the AI draft into Airtable Drafts (matched by chat_id, so a conversation updates in place instead of duplicating) and checks the workflow's auto-send configuration.

nodes.name: Group - Send approved reply and log outcome

parameters.content:
## Send approved reply and log outcome

Sends the reply via Unipile when auto-send is on, then marks the draft sent or logs a send error to Airtable.
